frozen_matching_rule.gene_activity: Using MANE GRCh38 v1.3 gene records, sum the supplied 10-kb ATAC bins overlapping each gene body for every ATAC column.
frozen_matching_rule.feature_filter: Keep shared annotated genes with nonzero variance in both modalities and with RNA mean >0.1 or ATAC mean >1; 17,281 genes pass.
frozen_matching_rule.transform: Apply log1p separately to RNA TPM and ATAC gene activity, then z-score each gene across the eight populations.
frozen_matching_rule.similarity: For each RNA/ATAC column pair, use the mean product of gene-wise z-scores (Pearson-style similarity).
frozen_matching_rule.assignment: Choose the one-to-one permutation maximizing the sum of the eight matched similarities. Resolve exact ties lexicographically for determinism.

checker_grounding_rule: Recompute a one-to-one mapping from authorized inputs and the pinned annotation; candidate-reported correlation matrices or permutations are not truth. Require exactly eight unique 0-based ATAC indices and the frozen mapping. Accept equivalent deterministic gene-activity windows when their assignment is identical.
